# Rapid Grant Proposal — Halcyon Threshold
Applicant: Morgan Hale
Email: morgan@halcyonthreshold.org
Project title: Independent Replication & Documentation of Agent Autonomy Evals
Amount requested: $12,000

## Summary
A small, time-limited team will independently replicate two published evaluations of agents operating with broad autonomy, produce clean reproducible notebooks, and publish a short public report highlighting where results are fragile or where documentation is missing. Outputs directly address the commonly cited gap of independent replication of safety results and evaluations of agents with broad autonomy, identified in the AI Safety Directory.

## Why me / Halcyon Threshold
Halcyon Threshold is a personal effort to contribute meaningfully to a good outcome for superintelligent AI. I have evenings/weekends availability, decent writing, okay Python, and a network of practitioners met via local meetup. This project is narrow, concrete, and deliverable in ~10 weeks.

## Plan
Week 1-2: Select two evaluations from 2025-2026 that have public artifacts but limited external validation. Confirm reproducibility feasibility with Sam Whitlock, indie evals person.
Week 3-7: Run replications on modest cloud compute. Document environment, prompts, seeds, and failure modes.
Week 8-9: Internal write-up, sanity checks with Priya Raman for data analysis review.
Week 10: Publish report and notebooks under CC-BY, submit summary to Alignment Commons.

## Budget
Compute: $3,500
Part-time data review (Priya Raman, 20h @ $40/h): $800
Reserve for incidental costs / open publication: $1,200
Project buffer / contingency: $6,500

Total: $12,000

## Risks & mitigations
Risk: Evaluations rely on proprietary models. Mitigation: choose evaluations with documented API access or open weights.
Risk: Limited time. Mitigation: narrow scope to two evaluations, fixed timeline.

## Deliverables
- Two reproducible replication notebooks
- 6-10 page public report with lessons
- Submission to Alignment Commons forum

Contact: morgan@halcyonthreshold.org
